findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the paper towel dispenser at the hand sink to not have paper towels inside. Notified the PIC that there were no paper towels, and PIC replaced new paper towels in the dispenser. Ensure hand sinks are stocked with paper towels at all times to allow for proper hand drying and faucet turning procedures.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: Inspector observed single-use service containers to be stored in boxes on the floor. Educated the PIC on the importance of keeping single-use service items off of the floor. Ensure all single-service containers are stored at least 6 inches off of the floor.

(A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
A mop was observed stored in the mop sink.  Discussed with PIC about storing mops inverted, hung, or in the drying compartment of mop bucket to allow proper air drying.  Ensure all staff know how to properly store a wet mop.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
